entries.german:
Konrad der Marschall von Mammertshofen vergleicht sich mit dem Kämmerer Ulrich von Trauchburg im Streit um ein Gut zu Roggwil.

Allen den, die dizen brieue lesint oder ho errint lesin, kunde ich Cůnrat der marschalch uon Maenbraehs||houen 1 aine warhait dirre dinge, so hie nah gischriben stâte. Ir sont alle wissin, dc ich mitte hern V olr. || uon Drupurg 2 dem kamerer des gozhuses ze sante Gallen vmbe den crieg, den wir mite ainandren hâten || vmbe dc guote ze Rogwile 3, des er phligte an des iez ginamptes gozhuses statte, alsus virrihte vnde a) gischaedin sint, dc ich ime allu iar sol han giwerte ze sante Martis tulte zwelfthalbis b) muttes kern sante Galler messe vnde zwelfthalbes Schillings phening, dc cînse ist vnde von dem selbin guote ze Rogwile gâte. Waer abir, dc ich den selbin cînse ze dem ê genampten tag nut enwertu, so sol er mir sinen bottin senden, vnde swie ich in c) denne ze mal nut enweren, so sol er mich d) ân zorn vnde ane clag phendin uf dem selbin gůte alt uf andren minen guetren, swa ich su han, vnde swas schadin uf die selbin phandung ane giuaerde gat, den sol er uf den selbin phendirn han e). Och ist dc da girêtte, dc dize schidung vnserm aenwedrem an sinem rehte herna gischadin sol. Vnde dc dize war si vnde veste bilibe, so gibe ich ime dize hantuesti bisigilt mitte minem ingisigil. Dize bischah ze sante Gallen, do von gottis giburte warin zwelfhundert vnde sehs vnde nuncig jar, an dem naehstin samstag nah aller haeligen tag, indic. der cehindin, da zegegin warint . . der porter von sante Gallin 4, her Eber. von BurgeIon 5, her R. von Roschach 6, her Eber. von Bichilnse 7, her Hainr. vnde her Cůnr. schekin f) uon Landegge 8, her Jo. von Schoninberg 9, her Bur. der vogte von Wartinse 10, die ritter sint g), Eglolf der alte von Rosinberg 11, Jo. von Luterberg 12, H. Meldeli 13, R. der vogte von Wartinse 14 vnde anderr biderber lute ginuoge.

Siegel: Siegel abh., schildf. 4,2/5 cm, +S.CVNRADI.MARSCALCHI.D.MAIBREHSHOVI.
entries.english:
Konrad, Marshal von Mammertshofen, settles his dispute with Chamberlain Ulrich von Trauchburg over an estate at Roggwil.

I, Cůnrat, Marshal von Mammertshofen, make known to all who read or hear this letter the truth of the following matter. I have settled and agreed with Lord Ulrich von Trauchburg, chamberlain of the church of St Gall, concerning the dispute we had with one another over the estate at Roggwil, which he administered on behalf of the aforesaid church, as follows: each year I am to pay him at St Gall, on the feast of St Martin, twelve and a half measures of grain and twelve and a half shillings in pennies as rent from that same estate at Roggwil. If I do not pay this rent by the stated date, he is to send me his messenger; if I then fail to answer him promptly, he may, without anger or complaint, distrain the same estate or any of my other estates wherever he finds them. Any damage caused by the distraint without deceit is to be borne by the distraint.

It is also agreed that this settlement is not to prejudice either of our rights thereafter. To make this agreement true and firm, I give him this charter sealed with my own seal.

Done at St Gall in the year of the Lord 1296, on the Saturday following All Saints’ Day, indiction 10. Present were the porter of St Gall; Lord Eberhard von Burgelon; Lord R. von Rorschach; Lord Eberhard von Bichilnse; Lords Heinrich and Cůnrat Schenk von Landegg; Lord Jo. von Schönenberg; Lord Burkhard, advocate of Wartensee, knights; Egilolf von Rosenberg der Ältere; Jo. von Luterberg; H. Meldeli; R. the advocate of Wartensee; and many other worthy people.

Seal: The seal is detached; shield-shaped, 4.2 × 5 cm, with the legend “Seal of Cůnrat, Marshal of Mammertshofen.”
